summary: Refresh native mailbox streams from durable message changes and avoid periodic whole-mailbox reads

replay.detail: The initial connection snapshot and existing recent-unoffered recovery remain. Steady reads use a per-connection durable cursor; seat declaration or rollout changes explicitly resynchronize. No history replay or projection rebuild is introduced.

schema.detail: Uses existing claim rowid, subject/kind and local-observation indexes; no schema migration, table, index or trigger is added.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Mailbox frames, durable message identities, canonical ordering, binding/incarnation fences and receipt acknowledgements retain their existing protocol. Notifications remain hints; durable cursor checks recover missed and coalesced wakes.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal runtime rollout is required.

manual.detail: No manual steps or starting-state transitions are required.

recovery.detail: Transient read failures reconnect under the existing owner and no-replay policy. The cursor and materialized connection state are disposable and reconstructed on reconnect.
